source.title: Lava Diving
source.description: Our lookouts tell me there's a big glowing rock stickin' out of the deepest part of the lava pools beneath the Cauldron. The elementals seem to react to this material, so I need ye to sneak in there and grab me a chunk of that rock. It's pretty hot down there in more ways than one, so I suggest ye bring a hearty supply of fire protection potions!
source.objective: Bring a chunk of Shimmering Molten Mineral to Hansel Heavyhands. You can find the shimmering molten crag within the Slag Pit lava pools, deep within the Cauldron.
source.completion: Hopefully we can use this to learn a bit more about what we are dealing with.
